required_preconditions: Content-level review of every affected day
Stable target IDs and explicit split/merge decisions
Validator support for variable subtopic counts
invariants: No source record is deleted or overwritten.
No candidate mapping is treated as approved.
No one-to-many mapping is auto-expanded into duplicated learning content.
Book/source references and original content IDs remain preserved.
No draft or unreviewed content becomes runtime eligible.
Unmapped or ambiguous records are quarantined for manual review.
Safety routing takes precedence over ordinary learning-path migration.
dry_run_steps: Resolve exact aliases and candidate crosswalk entries.
Classify each record as mapped_candidate, ambiguous, or unmapped.
Report one-to-many and many-to-one cases without applying them.
Check duplicate targets, orphan references, and preserved provenance.
Emit before/after counts and a rollback-ready report; do not write source data.

rollback.strategy: No-op by design; source data is never mutated.
